beats.note: Ripley's Believe It or Not printed the claim anyway.

beats.name: A Princeton rabbi
beats.role: Showed Einstein the Ripley's clipping. He laughed and said he never failed in mathematics.

beats.context: Einstein said he had mastered differential and integral calculus before reaching this age.

beats.text: At 16 he missed the standard in the general part of the 1895 ETH entrance test.
beats.note: He performed with distinction in physics and mathematics.

beats.text: In 1896 he earned the top grade, a 6, in algebra and geometry.

beats.line: The myth is easier to repeat than the record.
